quote: An array of UV-sensitive silicon photomultipliers (SiPMs) detects scintillation light from particle interactions in LXe.

The charge signal is envisioned to be read out on the anode by arrays of crossed strips, deposited on 10 × 10 cm2 dielectric tiles [26]. Compared to the wire readout used in EXO-200, the tile design simplifies construction and assembly.
